title: Cup and Saucer (tasse et soucoupe)
technique: soft-paste porcelain with underglaze blue decoration
description: The cobalt blue and white decoration that borders the edges of the cup and saucer was one of the earliest types of decoration used at the Saint-Cloud porcelain factory. This type of cup and saucer pair may have been called a trembleuse (trembler) due to the raised ring around the well of the saucer that would have secured the cup in trembling hands.
creditline: Bequest of Mrs. Everett R. Castle
